d:
The Lallantop’s Chunav Yatra has reached Jharkhand. Abhishek Tripathi and Vijay Kumar are exploring the state from various angles. The team reached Jamshedpur and spoke to Purnima Das Sahu, who is BJP candidate from Jamshedpur East seat. She is daughter in law of Jharkhand’s Ex CM Raghubar Das.
Lallantop ka salana adda laut aaya hai. dinank 22 navanbar se 24 navanbar tak, dilli ke mejar dhyan chand neshnal stediyam men... banie tin din ke lallantop adda ka hissa sirph 499 rupae men. rajistreshan ke lie lallantop.com pe die bainar pe klik kijie ya diskripshan me die link par klik kare.
